full_judgment:
Mr. B. K. Das, J:- This rule was issued calling upon the opposite party No. 1 to show cause as to why the order dated 17.5.07 passed by the Artha Rin Adalat No. 1, Dhaka in Review Miscellaneous Case 9 of 2007 arising out of order dated 20.02.06 passed by the learned Judge, Artha Rin Adalat No.4, Dhaka in Artha Execution case No.1167 of 2003 should not be set aside and or pass such other or further order or orders as to this court may seem fit and proper. 

 2. The opposite party No.1 Mary Janet Radrigues being third party filed an application in Artha Rin Execution Case No.1167 of 2003 impleading the present petitioner as the auction purchaser and the opposite party Nos.2-5 as plaintiff and defendants praying for removal of the signboard from the schedule property stating that she is the absolute owner and possessor of the property mentioned in the schedule to the petition and was enjoying the property without any let or hindrance from any quarter on payment of rent and taxes to the government and that few miscreants including the present petitioner hang the signboard upon the schedule land alleging that the said land was auction sold in aforesaid Artha Rin Execution Case No.1167 of 2003 and possession of the auction sold property was delivered. The property of the third party petitioner Mary Janet Radrigues was delivered to the auction purchaser-petitioner. It is also alleged that the third party Mary Janet Radrigues had no involvement anyway with Artha Rin Adalat Suit No.25 of 1998 which was subsequently re-numbered as Artha Rin Suit No.14 of 1999. It is also alleged that plot No.6 of Block B of Shamoli Housing Ltd. was the auction sold property but possession of Plot No.4 of Block B of Shamoli Housing Society Ltd. was delivered to the auction purchaser (petitioner herein) which was mortgaged to the bank (National Bank Ltd.) and the third party opposite party No. 1 Mary Janet Radrigues is the owner of plot No.4 of Block B of Shamoli Housing Society Ltd. and prayed for restoration of possession of her property of Plot No.4 of Block B of Shamoli Housing Society Ltd. On the said application the executing court appointed a Advocate Commissioner to hold a local inspection to report if plot No.4 of Block B of Shamoli Housing Society Ltd. is auction sold property. The Advocate Commissioner executed the writ and submitted his report stating that plot No.6 of Block B of Shamoli Housing Society Ltd. is the auction sold property while possession of plot No.4 of Block B of Shamoli Housing Society Ltd. was delivered to the auction purchaser (petitioner herein). On the basis of the report, the executing court by order dated 20.02.06 passed in Artha Rin Execution Case No.1167 of 2003 directed “দরখাস্তকারী মেরী জেনেট রোড্রিক্সকে তাহার দরখাস্তের তফশিল বর্ণিত ঢাকা জেলার ক্যান্টনমেন্ট থানাধীন তৌজি নং সাবেক ১৯৯ এস এ. ১৪ মৌজা-ফায়দাবাদস্থিত সি এস ৩৪ এস এ-৫৪ নং খতিয়ানের ১১৪২ নং দাগের ১১.০২ শতাংশ অন্দরে শ্যামলী হাউজিং লিঃ এর ব্লকের সাব প্লট নং-৪ এর ২১/২ কাঠা জমিতে পুনঃস্থাপন (restored to possession) করা হইল।” Challenging the aforesaid order the auction purchaser filed Writ Petition No.2276 of 2006 before the High Court Division and a Division Bench by order dated 14.03.06 summarily rejected the said application with the observation "However if by the order the petitioner is aggrieved can file proper application in the court for reviewing the order in accordance with law." The auction purchaser (the petitioner) then filed Review Miscellaneous Case No.8 of 2006 arising out of Artha Rin Execution Case No.1167 of 2003 praying for allowing the Review Miscellaneous Case upon setting aside order No.58 dated 20.02.06 under Order 47 rule 1 of the Code of Civil procedure. Thereafter Review Case No.8 of 2006 was transferred to the Artha Rin Adalat No.1, Dhaka and was re-numbered as Review Miscellaneous Case No.9 of 2007. The learned Artha Rin Adalat by the impugned order dated 17.05.07 considered the' facts and circumstances of the case and the report of the Advocate Commissioner including order dated 20.02.06 passed in Artha Rin execution case No.1167 of 2003 and rejected the review, application holding that there is no application of any of the elements of Order 47 fide I of the Code of Civil Procedure. 

 6. Mr. Md. Nazrul Islam, the learned Advocate appearing with the learned Advocate Mr. Minal Hossain for the opposite parties on the other hand, supports the decision of the court below and submits that no element of Order 47 rule I of the Code of Civil Procedure is attracted in the case and accordingly the court below committed no error in passing the impugned decision. 

 7. We have considered the submissions of the learned Advocate for both the parties and perused the impugned order including the order dated 20.02.06. We have quoted the ordering portion of the order passed on 20.02.06. In the facts of the case, it appears that plot No.6 of Block B of Shamoli Housing Ltd. was auction sold to the auction purchaser in Artha Rin execution Case No.1167 of 2003 but the baileef in collusion with others, possession of plot No.4 of Block B of Shamoli Housing Society Ltd. was delivered to the auction purchaser (petitioner herein) though the said property belonged to the third party-petitioner Mary Janet Radrigues. The auction purchaser is not without any remedy. The auction purchaser had purchased the property which was mortgaged in National Bank Ltd. and in Artha Rin Case No.1167 of 2003 the said mortgaged property was put to auction and was auction purchased by the auction purchaser but the mortgaged property appertaining to plot No.4 of Block B of Shamoli Housing Society Ltd. was never mortgaged to the National Bank Ltd. and the said property was never put to auction sale in Artha 11M Execution Case No.1167 of 2003 and the said plot No.4 of Block B of Shamoli Housing Society Ltd. which is not the subject matter of Artha Rin Execution Case No.I 167 of 2003 could not be put to auction and thus could not be auction purchased by the auction purchaser (petitioner herein). The petitioner's remedy get possession of his auction purchased property, which was mortgaged with the bank being plot No.6 of Block B of Shamoli Housing Society Ltd. The auction purchaser is also permitted to get possession through court and may apply to Artha Rin court in Artha Rin Execution Case No.1167 of 2003 to get delivery of possession of the auction sold property. The opposite party No.1 being a third party and his property being plot No.4 of Block B of Shamoli Housing Estate was never mortgaged to Bank and thus is not the subject matter of Artha Rin Execution Case No.1167 of 2003 and thus third party-petitioner (opposite party No. 1 herein) is not required to deposit any amount as required under section 32(2) of the Artha EM Adalat AM, 2003. In the aforesaid facts, we do not find any substance in this rule. 

 9. The order of stay of operation of the order dated 17.05.07 of the Judge of the Artha Rin Adalat No.1, Dhaka in Review Miscellaneous Case No.9 of 2007 and order dated 20.02.06 of the Judge of the Artha Rin. Adalat No.4, Dhaka in Artha Zari Case No.1167 of 2003 is vacated. 

 10. In the facts of the case we direct the petitioner to pay cost of Tk.5,000/- to the opposite party No.1 Mary Janet Radrigues.
